content: Memory and storage prices will be inflated for the foreseeable future, so we’re always happy to find a good deal on capable gaming hardware, like this discount on the Lenovo Legion Go S with a Z2 Go processor and SteamOS. Normally $1,137.41 (and selling for close to $1,000 at Best Buy), Lenovo has the handheld console on sale for just $635.54 when you use code EXTRASAVEAFF at checkout, the lowest price we’ve seen yet for this model. [Product: Lenovo Legion Go S with SteamOS (Z2 Go) | https://go.skimresources.com/?id=1025X1701640&xs=1&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.lenovo.com%2Fus%2Fvipmembers%2Fperksoffer%2Fen%2Fp%2Fhandheld%2Flegion-go-s%2F83l30030us] We reviewed both the Windows and SteamOS versions of this gaming handheld when it released in 2024, and found the latter to be a much more appealing option, largely thanks to the improved user experience that Windows has shown signs that it’s slowly catching up to. The Z2 Go chip isn’t all that impressive, with similar performance to the more expensive OLED Steam Deck, but it’s still a solid choice for indie games and more spec-intensive titles if you turn the settings down. The 8-inch IPS panel goes up to 120Hz, and has variable refresh rate, which helps the Legion Go S stand out among other options at the same price. Read our Lenovo Legion Go S (SteamOS) review.

chineseContent: 在可预见的未来，内存和存储价格将会上涨，因此我们总是很高兴能找到物美价廉的游戏硬件，例如配备 Z2 Go 处理器和 SteamOS 的 Lenovo Legion Go S 的折扣。通常售价为 1,137.41 美元（在百思买售价接近 1,000 美元），联想手持式游戏机​​在结账时使用代码 EXTRASAVEAFF 仅需 635.54 美元，这是我们见过的该型号的最低价格。 [产品：搭载 SteamOS 的 Lenovo Legion Go S (Z2 Go) | https://go.skimresources.com/?id=1025X1701640&xs=1&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.lenovo.com%2Fus%2Fvipmembers%2Fperksoffer%2Fen%2Fp%2Fhandheld%2Flegion-go-s%2F83l30030us]我们审查了该游戏的 Windows 和 SteamOS 版本2024 年发布时，我发现后者是一个更具吸引力的选择，这很大程度上要归功于 Windows 已经显示出正在慢慢追赶的用户体验的改善。 Z2 Go 芯片并不是那么令人印象深刻，其性能与更昂贵的 OLED Steam Deck 类似，但如果您调低设置，它仍然是独立游戏和规格更密集的游戏的可靠选择。 8英寸IPS面板高达120Hz，并具有可变刷新率，这有助于Legion Go S在同价位的其他选择中脱颖而出。请阅读我们的 Lenovo Legion Go S (SteamOS) 评论。
